body:
## Outcome

Publish one token source that reproduces the current Bloxwap palette accurately on web, iOS, and Android.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Extract existing authored brand and semantic values from packages/tokens; name surface, text, border, focus, action, market direction, positive/negative, warning, and chart roles.
- Generate CSS variables, typed JS/TS tokens, and native color outputs from the same source. Preserve authored web OKLCH/Display P3 and explicit sRGB fallbacks.
- Handle native color spaces explicitly: supported iOS P3 channels, Android sRGB, and third-party sRGB assets; do not pass CSS color functions directly to RN.
- Define supported theme/mode behavior from the HIG rules and adapters for Tailwind, NativeWind if selected, plain CSS, and chart consumers.
- Make token generation consumable outside the monorepo; remove dependence on unversioned generated-file copying.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generated outputs are reproducible and anti-drift checks compare them with the audited brand/source values.
- [ ] Representative colors render correctly on browser, iOS, and Android; tests cover semantic aliases, conversion, alpha, and fallback behavior.
- [ ] Every supported semantic text/fill pairing has recorded contrast results and an accessible choice when the brand pairing does not qualify.
- [ ] A consuming docs site, React fixture, and native fixture can use tokens without duplicating values or scanning sibling repo source.

## Prerequisites

- #5 — Bootstrap the HIG workspace and runnable web/native consumer fixtures

## References

- [Tokens](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/tokens)
- [Hyperliquid](https://github.com/bloxwap/hyperliquid/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Chart](https://github.com/bloxwap/chart/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Haptic](https://github.com/bloxwap/haptic/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Extract semantic design tokens and generate web/native color outputs
